identity.title: MIRACLE: I. Unveiling the multi-phase, multi-scale physical properties of the active galaxy NGC 424 with MIRI, MUSE, and ALMA

paper_type_evidence.quote: We combine new observations of NGC 424 obtained with the MRS as part of the MIRACLE survey (Marconcini et al. in prep.) with archival observations from VLT/MUSE and ALMA.

question.value: What are the multi-phase (ionised, warm and cold molecular) gas kinematics, dynamical mass and outflow properties in the circumnuclear region of the Seyfert II galaxy NGC 424?

evidence.quote: We present the analysis of the multi-phase gas properties in the Seyfert II galaxy NGC 424, using spatially resolved spectroscopic data from JWST/MIRI, part of the Mid-InfraRed Activity of Circumnuclear Line Emission (MIRACLE) program, as well as VLT/MUSE and ALMA.
we analysed archival ALMA 12-m array band 6 observations from program 2021.1.01150.S (P.I. A. Rojas)

analysis_steps.goal: Fit CO(2-1) line profile per spaxel

method.value: Single Gaussian fit per spaxel, tested with chi2 and Kolmogorov-Smirnov test

evidence.quote: a single Gaussian was sufficient to reproduce the line profile in each spaxel based on the $\chi^2$ and the Kolmogorov-Smirnoff test
based on the $\chi^2$ and the Kolmogorov-Smirnoff test

method.value: MOKA3D thin-disc multi-shell fit of rotation velocity, inclination and dispersion fixed after a single-shell fit

evidence.quote: We initially fitted a single-shell model to the entire disc to derive global best-fit estimates of the circular velocity, disc inclination, and intrinsic velocity dispersion.

key_parameters.value: PA fixed at 28 deg; 20 shells for CO(2-1)

assumptions.value: thin disc with height smaller than PSF; shell width = PSF FWHM

evidence.quote: we adopted a thin-disc geometry with a height smaller than the spatial PSF.
we also checked that our measured value for the disc position angle from MUSE data is consistent with the values estimated with the *PaFit* python package

results_numeric.quantity: Cold molecular outflow mass 1-sigma upper limit

findings_qualitative.value: No evidence of cold or warm molecular outflows; CO(2-1) and H2 are consistent with pure rotation.

evidence.quote: here confirms the pure rotating nature of the cold molecular phase in NGC 424

findings_qualitative.value: Velocity dispersion enhanced along the minor axis in all gas phases, perpendicular to the ionised outflow.

evidence.loc: 4.6 Enhanced velocity dispersion along the galaxy minor axis
evidence.quote: show an elongated enhancement of gas velocity dispersion along the disc minor axis

claims.hypothesis: Is there a cold molecular outflow in NGC 424?
claims.experiment: PVDs, channel maps and high-velocity RMS of ALMA CO(2-1)
claims.result: No emission in high-velocity channels; mass upper limit 3.3e6 Msun

evidence.quote: the velocity channel maps confirm the absence of outflowing gas in the cold and warm molecular phases

claims.hypothesis: Can multi-phase rotation curves yield the dynamical mass?
claims.experiment: MOKA3D disc fits to MIRI, ALMA, MUSE, then Freeman+NFW fit
claims.finding: Consistent rotation curve across phases from pc to ~5 kpc

evidence.quote: infer a dynamical mass of M$_{\rm dyn}$ = (1.09 $\pm$ 0.08) $\times$ 10$^{10}$ $\mathrm{M_\odot}$

claims.hypothesis: The ionised outflow causes enhanced dispersion along the minor axis
claims.experiment: Compared 3D outflow modelling with dispersion maps
claims.result: Dispersion enhancement perpendicular to outflow, no clear radio jet
claims.finding: Outflow may play a key role

evidence.quote: Our findings suggest that the outflow might play a key role in such enhancement by injecting energy into the host disc and perturbing the ambient material.

why_this_data.value: Cold molecular phase traced by archival ALMA CO(2-1) to complete the multi-phase view.

evidence.quote: To investigate the cold molecular gas phase in NGC 424 we analysed archival ALMA 12-m array band 6 observations

limitations_admitted.value: Observations cover only ~5 kpc, so DM density and scale length cannot be constrained simultaneously.

evidence.loc: 4.2 Rotation curve fitting and dynamical mass
evidence.quote: we cannot properly constrain simultaneously the dark matter characteristic density and length

referee_caveats_inferred: Dark matter scale length borrowed from the Milky Way
Inclination and dispersion fixed across the disc, possibly degenerate with rotation velocity
Interpretation of the dispersion enhancement as outflow-driven is not tested quantitatively
